one-place-for-every-deal.title: One place for every deal
one-place-for-every-deal.script: A deal board is the cashflow board for sales. Every prospect is a card, every stage is a column, so the whole pipeline sits in one place.

read-it-at-a-glance.title: Read it at a glance
read-it-at-a-glance.script: You read it at a glance: what sits in each stage, what it is worth per column, and the next step per deal. On a Monday morning, it tells you where to spend your week.

start-small.title: Start small
start-small.script: So start small. Track your deals in a simple pipeline, and know that a spreadsheet is enough. The tool is not the point, the habit is.
